scenario: No implicit timeout is injected per LCCO.7.5. A call with no `timeout` clause fires exactly one call — no additional synthetic timeout continuations are created on the adapter side.
rules_ds:
service svc.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 30_s
